title: Roo and Nuzzle Help a Friend
markdown:
OH! OH! Get ready for a super-duper story! It’s about Roo the kangaroo, and his best friend, Nuzzle the koala toy! Nuzzle is soft, like a fluffy cloud you can hug!

Roo and Nuzzle live in a bright, sunny field. Boing, boing, boing! Roo loved to hop. And Nuzzle, all snug in Roo’s pouch, loved to hop too!

Today was a special day! Roo had a bright yellow note with a big red heart for Mrs. Wombat. She makes the yummiest berry muffins! Roo wanted to put the note in the mailbox at the end of the path. What a super job!

"Come on, Nuzzle!" Roo chirped. "Mailbox job!" Boing! Boing! Boing!

The path had pretty flowers, like little nodding heads. Roo hopped past busy ants walking in a line. "Hello, ants!" he called. The ants wiggled their feelers back. Boing!

Then, Mr. Badger! He had a stripey nose and was digging. "Good morning, Mr. Badger!" Roo shouted. Mr. Badger gave a happy grunt. Boing! Saying hello made Roo and Nuzzle feel warm and happy! Boing!

Suddenly, Roo stopped hopping. Boing... stop! He heard a tiny little sound. It sounded… lost. Roo hopped closer to a big green leaf. And there she was! A teeny-tiny ladybug! Her bright red shell wasn't shiny. She wiggled her little legs sadly.

"Oh, hello!" said Roo softly. Nuzzle snuggled closer. "We're here to help!"

The ladybug looked up. "I can't find my way home," she whispered. Her voice was like a little sad bell. "I hid too well when we played!"

Roo’s big, bouncy heart went thump-thump-thump. "Don't worry!" he said kindly. "We can help! Helping you is a big, important thing!"

Roo looked all around. He saw bright pink flowers a little way off, near a little brook. "Are your friends there?" he asked, pointing. "Those pink flowers smell so sweet!"

The ladybug wiggled her feelers. A little bit of hope came. "Oh! Yes! My friends love the pink flowers!"

Roo carefully bent down. Nuzzle peeked out. "Hop on this!" Roo said gently, nudging a soft grass blade. Then, instead of big hops, Roo did little, gentle hops. Hop! Hop! Hop! He carried the ladybug safely to the pink flowers. She held on tight, her spots looking like shiny candies.

WHOOSH! A whole bunch of ladybugs came running out! "Daisy! You're back!" they cheered. The little ladybug, Daisy, wiggled with happiness. Her shell shone bright!

"Thank you, Roo! Thank you, Nuzzle!" Daisy chirped. Her voice was like a happy bell. "You are very kind friends!"

Roo felt a happy wiggle in his tummy. Helping Daisy felt even better than muffins!

"You're welcome!" Roo said, beaming.

Then, Roo remembered! "We still need to get to the mailbox, Nuzzle!" he said. "Have fun playing, Daisy! Bye-bye!"

With a wave to Daisy and her happy ladybug family, Roo started to hop again. Boing! Boing! Boing! He hopped past the ants. Boing! He hopped past Mr. Badger. Boing! The sun felt warm.

Finally, they saw it! The big, blue mailbox! Roo hopped right up to it. With a little wiggle, he popped the bright yellow note inside. WHOOSH! It was in! Click.

Roo did a happy dance, twirling. "We did it, Nuzzle! We did it! We delivered the thank-you note!"

Nuzzle swayed, all warm and cozy. They delivered the note and helped a new friend. And that, Roo thought with a happy sigh, was the very best kind of adventure of all. Boing!
characters: Roo the kangaroo joey, Nuzzle the koala toy
